titulo: claude-context-cost: what fills your Claude Code context
descricao: Choose a Claude Code transcript and see how many input tokens each CLAUDE.md, rule, skill, memory and tool result cost, counted from the API usage the transcript records, next to the usual characters / 4 estimate.

campos.rotulo: Transcript (.jsonl, from ~/.claude/projects). Without a file, the synthetic example runs.

rodape: One transcript at a time; a session's total does not include its subagents (each has its own file). The output count includes thinking.

textos.carregando: Loading Python in your browser (first visit only)…
textos.pronto: Ready. Run the synthetic example or choose one of your transcripts, then click the button.
textos.alterado: The file changed: run again to see the result.
textos.privacidade: Your transcript never leaves your computer: the library runs here, in your browser, with no server.
